description: This file contains unit tests for the 'cordz_info' component of the Abseil library, focusing on tracking, untracking, and managing cord information, including stack traces and reference counting.

classes.name: CordzInfo
classes.description: Class managing detailed information and lifecycle of a cord, including tracking, untracking, reference counting, and stack trace management.

classes.name: CordzSnapshot
classes.description: Snapshot of the current state of cordz info, used for thread-safe iteration.

classes.name: CordzHandle
classes.description: Handle class for managing cord lifecycle and diagnostics.

classes.name: TestCordData
classes.description: Test fixture data structure for creating and managing test cords.

classes.name: TestCordRep
classes.description: Test representation of a cord used in unit tests.

methods.name: TrackCord
methods.description: Tracks a cord with a specified method identifier.

methods.name: MaybeTrackCord
methods.description: Conditionally tracks a cord based on sampling and parent info.

methods.name: Untrack
methods.description: Untracks a cord, removing it from tracking and updating global state.

methods.name: SetCordRep
methods.description: Sets the internal representation of a cord, possibly nullifying it.

methods.name: RefCordRep
methods.description: Increments reference count for the cord representation.

methods.name: GetStack
methods.description: Retrieves the current stack trace for debugging.

methods.name: GetCordzStatistics
methods.description: Returns statistics related to cord tracking.
